loyalty.title: Loyalty
loyalty.description: Points for orders and actions, rewards, tiers and expiry, with the full history of every point.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Every customer with an account takes part. Click a customer to see the history.

notMember.guest: This customer has no account, so they collect no points.
notMember.excluded: This customer is in an excluded group: they neither earn nor redeem points.

adjust.title: Manual correction
adjust.hint: Entries are never edited or deleted: a mistake is fixed with another correction. Your user is recorded with it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Every rule of the program. Changes apply from the moment you save; past entries stay as they are.
settings.programHint: When off, nothing is earned or redeemed. History and balances stay.
settings.earnHint: Counted from products after discounts, without shipping and free gifts, once the order is paid. Always rounded down to a whole point.
settings.actionsHint: Each action counts once per customer (birthday once a year).

actions.signupHint: When a customer registers. Guests get nothing.
actions.first_orderHint: Extra points for the first paid order, on top of the usual points. Taken back if the order is canceled.
actions.birthdayHint: Once a year, on the date the customer sets in their account.
actions.newsletterHint: When another plugin reports a sign-up (the newsletter.subscribed event), or by hand on the customer's page.

settings.birthdayMinDays: Date set at least … before the birthday
settings.tiersHint: A tier depends on spend in the last months: products after discounts, minus returns. Customers move up and down by themselves.
settings.expiryHint: Points expire after a period without an order or a redemption. A negative balance never expires.
settings.returnOnExpiry: Give points back for reward codes that expire unused
settings.giftRelease: Remove a gift from an abandoned cart and give the points back after
settings.excludedHint: Customers in these groups (e.g. B2B) neither earn nor redeem points.
settings.currencyHint: Amounts in the program (spend thresholds, reward values) are in this currency.
settings.currencyMissing: The store no longer has {{currency}}. Choose one of the store's currencies.
settings.termsHint: Shown to customers by your storefront (Store API: GET /store/loyalty/terms and /store/loyalty/me). The plugin does not create the terms page itself; in Poland a loyalty program needs published terms.
settings.ratesHint: How much an order in another store currency counts in {{currency}}: for points, tier spend and returns. Without a rate, orders in that currency earn nothing.
settings.rateMissing: No rate: orders in {{currency}} earn no points.

preview.title: What the customer sees
preview.hint: The texts the store gets from the Store API, for a sample basket.
preview.saved: The preview uses the saved settings.

guide.title: How the program works
guide.subtitle: Every change of a balance is an entry in the ledger. The balance is always the sum of the entries.

start.title: Start
start.text:
1. Set how many points customers get on the Settings tab.
2. Add rewards on the Rewards tab.
3. Add a link to the program terms.
Every customer with an account takes part; guests collect nothing.

earning.title: Earning points
earning.text: Points are added once the order is fully paid: products after discounts, gross or net as set, without shipping. Always rounded down. The customer's tier multiplier applies. Free gifts earn nothing. An order never earns twice.

actions.title: Points for actions
actions.text: Account creation, first order, birthday and newsletter sign-up, each switched on separately with its own points. Each counts once (birthday once a year). The birthday date can be changed only once in the set period.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.text:
Amount, percentage and free shipping rewards create a one-off code only that customer can use, valid for the set number of days. A free product goes straight into the customer's cart at 0 zł; if it is out of stock, nothing happens and no points are taken. Removing it from the cart gives the points back.
Points are taken the moment a reward is redeemed. Two clicks at once never take them twice.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.text: A tier depends on spend in the last months (12 by default). Tiers are checked after every paid order and return, and every night, so customers also drop when old orders leave the window. A tier can give a one-off bonus, given the first time a customer reaches it.

expiry.title: Expiry
expiry.text: Points expire after the set time without an order or a redemption. Before that, the plugin emits a reminder event, which an e-mail plugin can turn into a message.

returns.title: Returns and cancellations
returns.text: Returned items take back their share of the points, by their value at purchase. A canceled order takes back everything. If the customer already spent the points, the balance can go below zero: they cannot redeem until new orders even it out.

ledger.title: The ledger
ledger.text: Every entry says what happened, how many points, why, and who did it. Entries are never changed or deleted, also not by the database. A mistake is fixed with a manual correction, which needs a reason.

storefront.title: For the storefront
storefront.text: The store reads the balance, history, rewards and the points a cart will earn from the Store API, and redeems rewards through it. Every rule is checked on the server. See the plugin README.

events.title: For other plugins
events.text: The plugin emits events (points earned, redeemed, expiring, tier changed and more) that an e-mail or newsletter plugin can use. It does not send e-mails itself.

demo.body: "Restore test data" replaces the whole program with a sample one: every rule on, a reward of every kind and a year of history for up to eight customers (tiers, orders, returns, redemptions, expired and expiring points, birthdays, manual corrections). Turn the demo option off in medusa-config.ts before going live.
demo.resetBody: Every loyalty record is deleted and replaced with test data: settings, rewards, accounts, the points history and redemptions. The store's registered customers get sample histories; a store with fewer than six gets sample customers (demo.…@example.com). This cannot be undone.
